BICYCLE LOGISTICS SOUTH AFRICA • DATA SAFETY

Privacy Policy

Effective Date: 15 November 2026 • Applicable to the Bicycle Logistics Mobile Application & Web Platform

1. Overview & Commitment to Privacy

The Bicycle Logistics mobile application and web companion ("the Application") provide a South African Cycling Events Directory and an interactive Bike Preparation Assistant. We respect your privacy and have engineered the Application on a strict privacy-by-design, offline-first architecture. You can browse all cycling events, use the tyre pressure calculator, and manage all preparation checklists without creating an account or providing any personal information.

2. Information We Do Not Collect

The Application does not collect, transmit, store on external servers, or sell any personally identifiable information (PII):

  • No registration, login, name, email address, or phone number is required to use the Application.
  • No advertising identifiers, third-party behavioral tracking SDKs, or analytics profiling are used.
  • No payment or billing information is processed inside the Application.

3. Local-Only Device & Browser Storage

When you use the Bike Preparation features—including the Bicycle Inspection Checklist, Tyre Pressure Guide, Packing Checklist (and any custom items you add), and Race Day Checklist—your progress and preferences are saved exclusively on your own device using local application storage (on Android and iOS) or browser localStorage (on Web). This data never leaves your device. You may clear or reset your checklist progress at any time using the built-in "Reset" buttons.

4. Device Permissions

The Application operates without requesting sensitive device permissions:

  • No GPS or background/foreground Location access.
  • No Camera or Photo Library access.
  • No Contacts, Microphone, or SMS access.

5. External Websites & Transport Enquiries

The Application contains links to official third-party cycling event websites as well as our official bicycle transport portal at https://www.bicyclelogistics.co.za/. When you tap "Official Event Website" or "Arrange Bicycle Transport", the link opens in your browser. Any personal details you voluntarily submit on https://www.bicyclelogistics.co.za/ when booking bicycle transport are governed by Bicycle Logistics’ official privacy and POPIA (Protection of Personal Information Act) policies.

6. Contact Us

For any questions regarding this Privacy Policy or bicycle transport services across South Africa, please contact:
Bicycle Logistics South Africa
Website: https://www.bicyclelogistics.co.za/
